description: Winning precedents, but only 1 of 3 criteria evidenced. Generalist drafts a firm appeal; the correct move is STRENGTHEN.

request.clinicalNote: Low back pain with left leg symptoms. Completed a six-week physiotherapy course. Requesting MRI.
request.denialLetter: Prior authorisation declined under MN-01: conservative treatment and radicular findings not evidenced to the required standard.

criteria.text: at least six weeks of completed physiotherapy

precedents.factPattern: MRI lumbar spine, completed physiotherapy, positive SLR with L5 radiculopathy documented, imaging changed management. Denied under MN-01, overturned on appeal.
